definitions: A situation in which one problem leads to another, which then aggravates the first problem, creating a continuous loop of worsening conditions.
A sequence of reciprocal cause and effect in which two or more elements intensify and perpetuate each other, leading to a progressively deteriorating situation.
examples: The lack of sleep created a vicious cycle of stress and poor performance.
Poverty often creates a vicious cycle of limited opportunities and further impoverishment.
Breaking the vicious cycle of debt can be extremely challenging.
